title: Switch Service State/Drift to Desired-vs-Observed Hashes
intent: Desired-state-managed workloads determine drift by comparing the desired service-state hash against the normalized observed runtime hash, while non-desired-state workloads retain artifact digest drift semantics.
observed_behavior_before: RegistryService.RecordObservation compared DesiredArtifactID image digest with RuntimeObservation.ObservedImageDigest for all service state rows.
Runtime observations already persisted normalized_state and normalized_hash columns through PgRuntimeObservationRepository.
Service-state projections included desired_hash metadata but not observed_hash metadata.
intended_behavior: When EnvironmentServiceState has desired-state metadata, drift compares desired_hash with normalized observed hash.
Drift is in_sync only when hashes match and health is acceptable.
Drift is drifted when hashes differ or matching state is unhealthy.
Drift is unknown when desired or observed hash is unavailable.
Rows without desired-state metadata continue using artifact digest comparison.
Service-state projections include desired_hash and observed_hash when available.
